title: a plan migrate names the proofs that read the plan it rewrites
intention: plan_migration's report names, for each ticket it changes, the tracked proofs that look the ticket up and read a plan field of it, and main prints them as the proofs to run.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: the outcomes migrate (commons 551ad436) reported 0 reds over 204 tickets, yet 149b9a1ab9c4's proof read the decisions it removed and sealed red (akienasus q132). Orchestrator 2026-11-16: 'a migrate must name the proofs that read a migrated ticket's plan fields, or run them'; the tooth goes in the migrate's own proof.
traces_to: Law 3: the migrate's '0 reds' was an unmeasured claim. Law 8: a hollow green is worse than a red.
how: plan_readers(repo, ids): an AST read of tracked proofs/*.py. A proof counts for an id when it hands the id (literal, module-level name or f-string part) to a call named *ticket* or a glob, and reads a plan field by subscript or .get. migrate(repo=) adds plan_readers to each report, defaulting to the cairn repo beside the commons; main prints them to stderr.

clauses.claim: in cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_every_open_plan_takes_the_outcomes_shape.py, test_the_report_names_the_proofs_that_read_the_plan: over a scratch commons with a git-indexed scratch cairn beside it, the changed ticket's report names exactly the tracked reader, and names no fixture-only proof, untracked reader or unchanged ticket; red on origin/main (KeyError plan_readers), and the nine aa3e9a70db47 teeth stay green

decisions.text: D1: plan_migration gains _lookups, plan_readers and _repo_beside; migrate takes repo= and adds plan_readers to every report; main lists the readers on stderr.
D2: tooth 10 in the migrate's proof, PROVES f13da082fca9 clause 1.

measured.saw: over the 204 tickets 551ad436 changed, plan_readers names exactly one proof, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_no_outside_proof_imports_build_inspector.py, for 149b9a1ab9c4
measured.how: plan_readers('.', ids) in wt-jp/cairn over the ids git show --name-only 551ad436 lists

measured.saw: tooth 10 red on the base (KeyError: plan_readers) and the proof 10/10 green on the fix
measured.how: PYTHONPATH=. python3 cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_every_open_plan_takes_the_outcomes_shape.py with plan_migration.py at HEAD, then at the fix
